Reports To: Vice President, Operations

This is an exempt position reporting to the Vice President, Operations. The Director of Payment Integrity is responsible for the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams. This role functions as both the director setting strategy for these departments and the direct supervisor managing day to day operations. This position interfaces with all departments of SIHO as well as external stakeholders, vendors, and customers. The ability to interact with all levels of SIHO staff and external parties with a high level of professionalism, while adapting quickly between multiple high priority items, is essential.

Brief Description of Duties:

  • Directly supervise and manage the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams, including day to day oversight, staffing, and performance management
  • Read, research, and interpret federal and state regulations governing grievances and appeals, and translate regulatory requirements into practical, actionable process changes
  • Continuously monitor and improve grievances and appeals processes to ensure ongoing compliance with CMS and state regulatory requirements
  • Support the claims and benefit configuration quality assurance program, including developing and delivering training and education for staff
  • Stay current on emerging fraud, waste, and abuse trends and lead efforts to proactively identify and investigate potential FWA
  • Review results across all three departments and identify process improvement initiatives and cost savings opportunities
  • Analyze department and operational data in Excel to identify trends and draw actionable insights
  • Manage data transfers with vendor partners, meet with vendors regularly to ensure processes are working as intended, and escalate potential issues as they arise
  • Interact directly with customers as needed
  • Work with SIHO Legal and key leadership on special cases and external inquiries from CMS, the Indiana Department of Insurance, law enforcement, and others
  • Develop, maintain, and report statistical measurements assessing the effectiveness of the QA, FWA, and G&A programs
  • Lead or support key corporate and departmental compliance initiatives, including SOC audits, CMS Part C Reporting and ODAG, and others as assigned

Minimum Skills Requirement:

  • B.S. degree or equivalent work experience in a healthcare operation
  • 3-5 years experience in a managed care environment
  • Strong understanding of federal and state regulations related to grievances and appeals, including CMS and state Department of Insurance requirements
  • Experience across Medicare Advantage, ACA, employer group/TPA, and MEWA products preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and manage people and teams, while also directly supervising staff on a daily basis
  • Proficient in Excel with the ability to analyze data and draw actionable insights
  • Thorough understanding of medical and health plan terminology; familiarity with CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding a plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate with all levels of management as well as external entities, vendors, and customers
  • Ability to work successfully at a self-directed pace in a changing, fast-paced, high demand environment, adapting quickly between competing high priority items
  • Ability to work successfully under tight deadlines
  • Experience with SIHO systems including the HSP claims system
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite products including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

All positions are subject to change based on the needs of the business.

description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do

  • Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

  • Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

  • Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

  • Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

  • Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

  • Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

  • Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

  • Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

  • Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

  • AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

  • High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

  • Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit

  • Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

  • MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

  • Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting

  • Competitive, top-of-market compensation

  • You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

  • Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

  • Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

description:
About Delinea:
Delinea is a pioneer in securing human and machine identities through intelligent, centralized authorization, empowering organizations to seamlessly govern their interactions across the modern enterprise. Leveraging AI-powered intelligence, Delineaâs leading cloud-native Identity Security Platform applies context throughout the entire identity lifecycle â across cloud and traditional infrastructure, data, SaaS applications, and AI. It is the only platform that enables you to discover all identities â including workforce, IT administrator, developers, and machines â assign appropriate access levels, detect irregularities, and respond to threats in real-time. With deployment in weeks, not months, 90% fewer resources to manage than the nearest competitor, and a 99.995% uptime, Delinea delivers robust security and operational efficiency without compromise. Learn more about Delinea on Delinea.com, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

Join our passionate, global team at Delinea and help us make the world a safer and more secure place. Our success is driven by world-class product leadership, outstanding engineers, and strategic investment from TPG. We value diversity, innovation, and a culture of respect and fairness. If you're ready to push boundaries and challenge the status quo in security, we want to hear from you.
Â 

Apply today to help us achieve our mission.

Delinea secures human, machine, and AI identities, eliminating standing privilege and reducing the attack surface across on-premises and cloud. As the platform expands into Non-Human Identity governance, AI agent identity, StrongDM, and consumption-based licensing, we are hiring a dedicated leader to own how we package value and price capability across the whole portfolio. This is a horizontal L-1 role, peer to the General Managers of Workforce, Workload and AI, reporting to the Chief Product Officer.

What You Will Own

  • Price and packaging architecture across the portfolio: tiering, licensing metrics, add-on structure, bundling.

  • Proposal quality into our monthly Price Committee: the analysis, the financial model, the recommendation, and the action register through to closure.

  • Discount governance, including band policy and the guardrails behind it.

  • Monetization for new categories: NHI governance, AI agent identity, StrongDM, consumption-based licensing.

  • Commercial readiness at launch, so packaging and pricing ship with the product.

  • The single source of truth for pricing, packaging and quoting guidance, partnering with Product Marketing on seller enablement.

  • Price realization, attach rate and competitive position, informed by competitor pricing, market benchmarks and win/loss data.

What We Are Looking For

  • 12+ years across pricing strategy, monetization, product management or product marketing, including 5+ years owning pricing as a named function.

  • A track record of building a monetization function where none existed: cadence, governance, documentation, analytical bench.

  • Experience preparing and defending recommendations to a formal pricing committee or equivalent decision body.

  • Demonstrated design of tiered packaging for enterprise software, and strong financial modeling (pricing impact, ARR and expansion, discount optimization).

  • Credibility with executive peers, holding a position on pricing under pressure without direct authority over sales or finance.

Strongly preferred

  • Cybersecurity or identity security (PAM, IAM, SIEM, endpoint); exposure to NHI, machine identity or secrets management.

  • Consumption-, usage-, or outcome-based pricing models alongside seat-based subscription.

  • Working knowledge of CPQ (Salesforce CPQ, Apttus); pricing through M&A integration or a major commercial model transition. MBA a plus.

Why Now

Pricing at Delinea has been carried by people doing it well alongside a full portfolio, and the surface area keeps growing. The opportunity is to make monetization a professional discipline, with a decision forum that already works. If you want to own monetization end-to-end rather than manage an approval queue, this role is built for it.

Why work at Delinea?

  • We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.

  • We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.

  • What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.

At Delinea, our core values are STRONG and guide our behaviors and success:

  • Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do

  • Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments

  • Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team

  • Ownership - We take initiative and follow through

We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.

We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays.

Â

KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

description:

Blackbird Interactive is looking for an experienced Senior Level Designer to help build and deliver high-quality gameplay spaces for an action RPG focused on fast-paced combat, character progression, exploration, and replayability. This role focuses on designing levels, encounters, and environments that create satisfying combat opportunities, reward exploration, and support a wide variety of player builds and abilities.

You'll work closely with systems design, combat design, art, narrative, audio, and engineering to create spaces that complement the game's core combat systems while providing strong pacing, readability, and a sense of discovery. The role involves collaborating with leadership to align content with the overall creative vision while owning levels end-to-end, from initial layout and blockout through implementation, iteration, and polish. As a senior designer, you'll be expected to independently solve complex level design problems, provide strong design judgment, and help establish a high quality bar for playable content across the game.

\n


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with combat, systems, narrative, art, engineering, audio, and production to create levels that support the established creative vision and core gameplay pillars

  • Own levels end-to-end, including layouts, blockouts, combat spaces, encounters, traversal, exploration, pacing, and player flow

  • Design engaging combat spaces that support varied enemies, character builds, abilities, positioning, and different approaches to combat

  • Create rewarding exploration through optional paths, secrets, environmental storytelling, and meaningful rewards while maintaining clear navigation and progression

  • Script and implement gameplay events, encounters, objectives, triggers, and environmental interactions directly in engine

  • Test, debug, and iterate on levels using playtest feedback to improve combat flow, difficulty, pacing, readability, and replayability


Requirements

  • A minimum of 8 years of game development experience, with significant experience designing and implementing levels for action, RPG, or combat focused games

  • Experience shipping multiple titles, including at least one in a senior or equivalent level design role

  • Proven ability to independently own complex levels from initial concept and blockout through implementation, iteration, and final polish

  • Strong understanding of action RPG level design, including combat spaces, encounter pacing, exploration, progression, player guidance, and replayability

  • Strong hands-on experience with level editing, gameplay scripting, and in-engine implementation, with the ability to prototype, debug, and iterate quickly

  • Strong design judgment, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to balance gameplay quality, creative goals, technical constraints, and production realities


Pluses

  • Passion for action RPGs centered on combat, character builds, loot, progression, and exploration

  • Experience designing levels for an isometric or elevated gameplay camera, with an understanding of its impact on combat readability, navigation, and composition

  • Experience creating replayable content that supports different character builds, abilities, difficulty levels, or repeated playthroughs

  • Appreciation for systemic combat and how level geometry, enemy composition, hazards, and interactive elements combine to create varied encounters

  • Experience designing dungeons, interconnected environments, procedural or modular level content, or other repeatable gameplay spaces

  • Strong instincts for environmental storytelling, gameplay readability, polish, and identifying opportunities to improve the player experience through iteration

Orca Bio is a commercial-stage biotechnology company redefining the transplant process by developing next-generation cell therapies with the goal of providing significantly better survival rates with dramatically fewer risks. With our purified, high-precision cell therapies we hope to not only replace patients' blood and immune systems with healthy ones, but also restore their lives.


The Senior Specialist, Global QMS will help implement Orca Bioâs global quality management system across all sites.   • Establish and monitor global QMS key performance indicators (KPIs), oversee trending of quality metrics, and ensure data-driven insights are used to improve quality systems and performance.

Experience:

  • Proven experience leading Quality Management Review, internal audit programs, supplier management processes, and validation oversight.

Overview

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

  • Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

  • We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

  • Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

  • You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

  • A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

  • Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

  • Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

  • Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â 

How We Work

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Â 

Location and Compensation

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join Pivotal's Case Execution team. This team owns critical parts of the case execution workflow, including eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. title: Surveyor I
description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

description:
About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Deployment Strategist to join our team. In this role, you'll partner with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) across the full deployment lifecycle, from first discovery conversation to live production. You'll lead use case discovery and scoping with senior customer stakeholders, ship prototypes hands-on to prove value early, then stay close to the build through delivery to bring the strategic, business-value lens to every decision. You're the partner who keeps the work pointed at the highest-impact outcomes, ready to pick up the keyboard alongside the FDE when the moment calls for it.

We're looking for engineers with strategic instincts: people who can write code, but whose deepest strength is the strategic, opinionated lens they bring across every phase of a deployment - spotting where value lives, scoping it realistically, and partnering with engineers to capture it from prototype to production.

At HappyRobot, there's no role seniority or hierarchy. We operate as a team of builders. We execute, we build, we own, and we care deeply about our customers and their success.

What You'll do

  • Strategic Leadership and Use Case Discovery: Partner with Global and Regional C-Level executives and VPs to assess AI opportunities and prioritize the highest-impact use cases. Lead curiosity-driven discovery that surfaces the workflows where AI creates the most business value, well beyond what the customer thought to ask for. Build the trusted relationships that let you present findings and challenge assumptions at the most senior levels, keeping technical delivery aligned with their business priorities.

  • Scoping: Frame impact versus effort with rigor on both axes. On business value, pressure-test the realistic upside, question whether the use case as posed will actually deliver the most impact, and explore whether reframing it or pivoting to an adjacent process would unlock more. The art is deeply understanding how to maximize value of this use case for the customer, not just delivering what was asked for. On technical effort, map integrations, data, and platform constraints, and surface the edge cases and dependencies that shape timelines. Land on a plan that's realistic on both.

  • Prototyping: Build prototypes and demos hands-on. Use our platform and AI-powered coding tools to test ideas end-to-end at light scope. Prove value early, before the customer commits.

  • Program Management: Coordinate work across the active deployments in an account. Be the escalation point for the customer and the watchout partner for the FDE. Stay close enough to the build that you both understand the use case deeply, spot opportunities to capture more value, and catch when work is drifting from the highest-impact path.

  • Prioritization: Sequence use cases within an account so each deployment compounds the next. Make the call on what gets built when, what gets parked, and where to invest discovery and building time.

  • Customer Partnership: Be the main business-side point of contact for the account. Build trust with operational and executive stakeholders day-to-day. Translate AI capabilities into language they can act on.

  • Onsite Embedding: Travel onsite for kickoffs, mapping sessions, and key moments where being on the ground changes the outcome.

  • Product Feedback Loop: Bring field signal back to Product and Engineering. Identify reusable patterns, common edge cases, and where the platform needs to evolve.

Must Have

  • Background that mixes technical depth with strategic instinct, and a real history of building things. Common paths include engineering (Computer Science, electrical, industrial, systems), data science, founding a tech startup, product management, or technical / strategic consulting.

  • Comfortable coding -mostly Python- using LLMs and AI-powered tools like Claude Code to ship prototypes fast.

  • Working understanding of APIs, integrations, and how AI agents sit inside enterprise workflows.

  • Strategic instinct: ability to spot the business value behind a workflow and translate it into impact, effort, and prioritization terms a C-level can act on.

  • Excellent communication skills with both executives and operators. Comfortable translating between business and technical without losing either side.

  • Proven ability to prioritize ruthlessly across multiple workstreams and drive outcomes, not just activity.

  • Founder mindset: highly independent, takes ownership, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

Why join us?

  • Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

  • Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

  • Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

  • Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

  • Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

Our Operating Principles


Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

description:
Ready to Take on a New Challenge in Enterprise Sales?

Are you a driven, energetic sales professional looking for your next big adventure? Do you thrive on taking ownership, unlocking strategic accounts, and closing complex, high-value deals in a fast-paced environment? Where You’ll Make an Impact:

You’ll gain deep product expertise and apply your understanding of evolving global and regional regulations to build compelling business cases that speak directly to our customers’ pain points.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone looking for a role where you can make an impact not just on the company you work for but also on the market you work in. Fascinating and challenging work is the norm - working at Elliptic is never boring!

What you will do:

  • Run the full enterprise sales cycle, from pipeline generation to deal closure, across a territory with massive potential and that has considerable inbound interest.

  • Proactively identify, engage, and convert strategic enterprise accounts (including pre-defined targets and new prospects).

  • Develop and execute multi-threaded sales strategies to engage diverse stakeholders (compliance, legal, risk, procurement, tech, C-level).

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
About pplwise

pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics.

About our client: Filics

Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Supply Chain Manager (m/f/d) at Filics, you will build the supply chain that takes the robots into series production.

About the role

This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly.
Filics robots are built from hundreds of components. Many come from a single source, and most aren’t under contract yet. Moving from prototypes to series production, one missing part can stop the whole line. Your job is to build a robust supply chain from scratch. It needs to know exactly what Filics depends on, secure those parts before they become a risk, and hold up as volumes grow, all while production is already running. You take full ownership of how every component is sourced, secured and managed.
You’ll work closely with Engineering, which owns the technical specs and qualifies suppliers and alternative components. Assembly depends on reliable supply to plan builds. Leadership sets volume commitments based on your analysis.

What you’ll do

  • Identify critical dependencies, lock in availability through supplier contracts, and qualify alternatives so no single source can stop production

  • Set up the ERP and the systems the supply chain runs on, including supplier quality tracking

  • Define clear quality criteria for suppliers and components together with Engineering

  • Give the assembly team the forward visibility they need to plan builds

  • Turn supply analysis into input for Leadership’s volume commitments

  • Once supply is robust, reduce component prices toward a leaner bill of materials

About you

  • Several years in supply chain, procurement or sourcing for hardware products (e.g. robotics, automotive, machinery, electronics)

  • Proven experience moving products from prototype to series production

  • A solid grasp of BOMs, component sourcing, supplier qualification and supplier quality

  • Strong negotiation skills and experience closing supplier contracts

  • A hands-on, structured approach: you prioritize well, work comfortably without defined processes, and deliver

  • Clear, concise communication in English and German

What Filics offers

  • Full ownership of a function you build yourself, with direct impact on getting the robots into series production

  • A small, ambitious team where initiative leads to responsibility

  • Work on a first-of-its-kind product in intralogistics

  • An on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to Engineering and Assembly

Sound like you? Apply with your CV.

Filics denkt Intralogistik neu und entwickelt autonome mobile Roboter (AMR), die verändern, wie Material bewegt wird. Mit dem Double-Runner-System ist Filics der erste und einzige AMR, der durch Ladungsträger wie Europaletten fahren kann. So löst sich Filics von der klassischen Staplerlogik und setzt einen neuen Standard für Effizienz. Das kleine Team packt selbst mit an und löst schwierige Probleme mit exzellenter Ingenieursarbeit. Verantwortung bekommt, wer Initiative zeigt und zuverlässig liefert. Als Supply Chain Manager (m/w/d) bei Filics baust du die Lieferkette auf, mit der die Roboter in Serie gehen.

Über die Rolle

Die Position ist onsite bzw. hybrid in München angesiedelt, nah an Engineering und Montage.
Die Roboter von Filics bestehen aus hunderten Komponenten. Viele davon kommen von nur einem Lieferanten, und die meisten sind noch nicht vertraglich abgesichert. Auf dem Weg vom Prototyp in die Serienfertigung kann ein einziges fehlendes Teil die ganze Linie stoppen. Deine Aufgabe ist deshalb, eine robuste Supply Chain von Grund auf aufzubauen. Sie soll genau wissen, wovon Filics abhängt, Risiken frühzeitig absichern und mit steigenden Stückzahlen mitwachsen, und das alles, während die Produktion bereits läuft. Du übernimmst die volle Verantwortung dafür, wie jede Komponente beschafft, abgesichert und gemanagt wird.
Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Engineering zusammen. Engineering verantwortet die technischen Spezifikationen und qualifiziert Lieferanten und alternative Bauteile. Die Montage braucht eine verlässliche Versorgung, um Builds zu planen. Die Geschäftsführung legt auf Basis deiner Analysen die Volumenzusagen fest.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Kritische Abhängigkeiten identifizieren, Verfügbarkeit über Lieferantenverträge sichern und Alternativen qualifizieren, damit keine Single-Source-Abhängigkeit die Produktion stoppt

  • ERP und die Systeme aufbauen, auf denen die Supply Chain läuft, inklusive Tracking der Lieferantenqualität

  • Gemeinsam mit Engineering klare Qualitätskriterien für Lieferanten und Komponenten definieren

  • Der Montage die Vorausschau geben, die sie für die Planung der Builds braucht

  • Supply-Analysen in Entscheidungsgrundlagen für die Volumenzusagen der Geschäftsführung übersetzen

  • Sobald die Versorgung steht, Komponentenpreise senken und die Stückliste (BOM) schlanker machen

Über Dich

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Supply Chain, Einkauf oder Sourcing für Hardware-Produkte (z. B. Robotik, Automotive, Maschinenbau, Elektronik)

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung auf dem Weg vom Prototyp in die Serienfertigung

  • Fundiertes Verständnis von Stücklisten, Komponentenbeschaffung, Lieferantenqualifizierung und Lieferantenqualität

  • Ausgeprägtes Verhandlungsgeschick und Erfahrung im Abschluss von Lieferantenverträgen

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise mit Hands-on-Mentalität: Du setzt die richtigen Prioritäten, arbeitest gern ohne festgelegte Prozesse und lieferst

  • Klare, präzise Kommunikation auf Deutsch und Englisch

Das bietet Filics

  • Volle Verantwortung für eine Funktion, die du selbst aufbaust, mit direktem Einfluss darauf, dass die Roboter in Serie gehen

  • Ein kleines, ambitioniertes Team, in dem Initiative zu Verantwortung führt

  • Arbeit an einem Produkt, das es in der Intralogistik so noch nicht gibt

  • Eine Onsite- bzw. Hybrid-Rolle in München, nah an Engineering und Montage

  • Proaktive Art: Du erkennst Probleme früh und klärst sie, bevor jemand nachfragen muss

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch

  • Lust auf eine Onsite-Rolle in München

  • Ein Plus: Erfahrung mit Zoll und internationalem Versand (z. B. Ausfuhranmeldung, ATLAS, Incoterms), Wareneingangsprüfung, ERP-Systemen (z. B. SAP MM, Odoo, Xentral, Business Central), Gefahrgut wie Lithiumbatterien oder Erfahrung aus einem Hardware-Startup

  • Echte Wachstumsperspektive: Du bist von Anfang an Teil des neuen Supply-Chain-Teams

description:
Über pplwise

pplwise ist eine Recruiting-Beratung für schnell wachsende Technologieunternehmen in Europa. Mit Recruiting as a Service und Executive Search besetzen wir Schlüsselrollen für unsere Kunden, von Start-ups bis zu börsennotierten Unternehmen. Diese Position besetzen wir für unseren Kunden Filics.

Über unseren Kunden: Filics

Filics denkt Intralogistik neu. Das Team entwickelt autonome mobile Roboter (AMR), die grundlegend verändern, wie Material bewegt wird. Mit dem Double-Runner-System ist Filics der erste und einzige AMR, der durch Ladungsträger wie Europaletten fahren kann. So löst sich Filics von der klassischen Staplerlogik und setzt einen neuen Standard für Effizienz. Das kleine, fokussierte Team löst schwierige technische Probleme mit exzellenter Ingenieursarbeit. Als Operative*n Einkäufer*in (m/w/d) bei Filics bringst du ein Produkt, das es so noch nicht gibt, in die Serienfertigung.

Über die Rolle

Du arbeitest vor Ort in München, direkt neben Montage und Engineering.
Filics geht jetzt vom Prototyp in die Serienfertigung, und die Stückzahlen steigen deutlich. Die Roboter bestehen aus hunderten Komponenten, von Elektronik und Sensorik bis zu Motoren und Kabelkonfektionen. Jedes Teil muss zur richtigen Zeit, in der richtigen Menge und in der richtigen Qualität da sein. Du bist die erste Person, die sich ganz auf den Einkauf konzentriert. Damit hältst du die Produktion am Laufen und baust die Strukturen auf, auf denen das künftige Supply-Chain-Team aufsetzt.
Du berichtest an den VP Operations. Gleichzeitig stellt Filics eine*n Supply Chain Manager*in ein. Diese Person baut die übergreifende Supply-Chain-Struktur auf und führt die Verhandlungen mit den Lieferanten. Du arbeitest eng mit ihr zusammen und berichtest später an sie. Im Alltag stimmst du dich außerdem eng mit Montage, Engineering und Finance ab.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Beschaffung aller Komponenten für die Montage, von Katalogteilen wie Motoren bis zu kundenspezifischen Kabelkonfektionen

  • Festlegung von Mindest- und Meldebeständen für kritische Teile und Erkennen von Engpässen schon Wochen im Voraus

  • Aufbau einer Lieferantenübersicht und eines Bestelltrackers, damit du jederzeit weißt, was bestellt, unterwegs und angekommen ist

  • Prüfen, ob Lieferungen vollständig und pünktlich ankommen, und eigenständiges Nachhaken bei Verzögerungen

  • Organisation des Versands der Roboter an Kunden und Partner von A bis Z, inklusive Zollpapieren, Incoterms und Speditionen, auch in die Schweiz

  • Wareneingangsprüfung (z. B. Kabelkonfektionen, Maße, sichtbare Mängel) und Klärung von Problemen mit Lieferanten, bevor die Teile in die Montage gehen

Über Dich

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im operativen Einkauf technischer Komponenten, idealerweise aus Elektronik, Elektromechanik oder Antriebstechnik

  • Erfahrung auf dem Weg vom Prototyp über die Kleinserie bis in die Serienfertigung (z. B. in Maschinenbau, Automatisierung, Robotik oder Elektronik)

  • Sehr genaue, strukturierte Arbeitsweise. Bei dir geht nichts verloren, und Tracker und Übersichten baust du dir selbst

  • Proaktive Art: Du erkennst Probleme früh und klärst sie, bevor jemand nachfragen muss

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch

  • Lust auf eine Onsite-Rolle in München

  • Ein Plus: Erfahrung mit Zoll und internationalem Versand (z. B. Ausfuhranmeldung, ATLAS, Incoterms), Wareneingangsprüfung, ERP-Systemen (z. B. SAP MM, Odoo, Xentral, Business Central), Gefahrgut wie Lithiumbatterien oder Erfahrung aus einem Hardware-Startup

Das bietet Filics

  • Verantwortung von Anfang an: Deine Entscheidungen sorgen direkt dafür, dass die Roboter in Serie gehen

  • Raum zum Gestalten: Du baust Strukturen auf, statt sie nur zu verwalten, und gute Ideen werden schnell umgesetzt

  • Echte Wachstumsperspektive: Du bist von Anfang an Teil des neuen Supply-Chain-Teams

  • Ein starkes Team aus sehr smarten, engagierten Menschen, die voneinander lernen und gemeinsam schwierige Probleme lösen

  • Ein Produkt, das es so noch nicht gibt: der erste AMR, der durch Europaletten fährt

  • Mitten im Geschehen: Du arbeitest in München direkt neben Montage und Engineering und siehst jeden Tag, was deine Arbeit bewirkt

Klingt nach dir? Bewirb dich mit deinem Lebenslauf.

title: Pricing & Deal Desk Manager (m/f/d)
description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

We're hiring a Pricing & Deal Desk Manager within the Revenue Operations team. You'd take ownership of one of Moss's highest-leverage commercial functions: the pricing deal desk. It's already delivered real results, and it matters more every quarter as deal volume grows and Moss moves into bigger, more complex deals.

What makes the role unusual is that the desk already runs on AI. An agent picks up each request, pulls the deal's scoring and call history, calculates margin, and drafts a reasoned reply; you approve, correct, or overrule it. So the job is two things at once: the reviewer who decides live deals, and the person who builds & improves the AI-based deal desk agent

Your responsibilities

  • Own the day-to-day approval flow for non-standard pricing, discounts, and commercial terms, acting as the fast, consistent escalation point for reps without slowing deals down.

  • Build and evolve pricing governance, including discount rules, approval thresholds, and playbooks, converting recurring exceptions into documented policy.

  • Drive deal health across the funnel: discount discipline, price realization, deal structure, and win rate by segment, diagnosing where deals leak value and fixing it.

  • Translate customer segmentation into differentiated pricing guidance and deal strategies, partnering with Sales to get it applied in real deals, and getting it into the ruleset so it's applied consistently.

  • Coach reps on pricing confidence and value-based selling

  • Partner with Customer Success to adapt the pricing and deal playbook for consistency after the sale.

About you

  • Proven experience in a deal desk, pricing, commercial, revenue operations, or sales-strategy role, ideally in B2B SaaS or fintech. Experience standing up or scaling a deal desk or pricing process from scratch is a plus.

  • Strong analytical toolkit, including SQL and/or advanced spreadsheet modeling.

  • The ability to leverage AI to build a scalable Pricing Deal Desk model, or the appetite to learn it. The direction is a low-touch desk: the agent executes the rules, its output gets better as you correct it, and each additional deal costs less human attention than the last

  • Fluent in English; German or Dutch is a plus.

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

  • Comfortable holding the line with Sales on discount governance while staying a genuine partner to the team.

  • A critical eye for AI output. The agent is sometimes confidently wrong, and catching that before a rep acts on it is part of the job.

  • Brings commercial judgment: understands how reps sell and how price sensitivity shifts across customer segments.

  • Structured and high-ownership, at ease in a fast, low-process, high-change environment.

  • Able to move fluidly between detailed data analysis and higher-level strategic thinking.

About Moss

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star.

We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA: playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect:

  • Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. 

  • Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.

  • Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.

Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).

By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our Data Privacy Policy.

title: (Senior) Quality Assurance Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
ZEAL Network SE is a dynamic, international group of companies that has been creating exciting and innovative lottery experiences for over 20 years. As Germany’s largest provider of online lotteries through our brands LOTTO24 and Tipp24, and a trusted partner of Spain’s ONCE, the second-largest national lottery, we’re shaping the future of the lottery industry. We are passionate about driving innovation, as demonstrated by our newest brands, Freiheit+ and Traumhausverlosung, which bring fresh and exciting dreams to life. Additionally, through ZEAL Ventures, we invest in inspiring e-commerce start-ups like Omaze and DAYMADE, fueling fresh ideas and opportunities.

Our team of 350+ professionals from diverse backgrounds is united by a visionary mindset, a passion for collaboration, and a commitment to inspire dreams. At ZEAL, we empower our people to think ambitiously and work together toward a shared purpose: helping people imagine and achieve their aspirations.

As a (Senior) Quality Engineer (f/m/d) in our Backoffice Team, you will help shape a new internal platform used across ZEAL to support business-critical operational workflows.

You will join a small cross-functional team and have a high level of ownership from the start. The Backoffice integrates with a wide range of backend services and supports workflows that can have financial, operational and compliance impact. Your work will directly influence how confidently and quickly we can deliver new functionality.

This is an engineering-focused quality role. You will work directly in the application codebase alongside the engineers and build the tooling, infrastructure and automated feedback loops that help the team ship safely at high speed.

Your tasks:

  • Shape and continuously improve the quality engineering strategy for the Backoffice application

  • Design and build automated test infrastructure across unit, integration, API and end-to-end levels with a strong focus on Playwright and TypeScript

  • Develop reusable test fixtures, test-data seeding, environment tooling, harnesses and abstractions that make realistic and repeatable testing easy.

  • Build fast automated feedback loops and validation mechanisms that make AI-assisted development safer and more effective.

  • Design meaningful regression coverage for critical workflows, complex permissions and scenarios with financial, operational or compliance impact

  • Strengthen CI quality gates and improve test execution so that a green pipeline provides a strong and fast signal that changes are safe to ship.

  • Investigate defects, flaky tests and systemic quality issues and turn findings into durable engineering improvements.

  • Triage bug reports together with internal users, reproduce issues and turn findings into clear actions for the team.

  • Champion a strong quality mindset across the team and challenge workflows and designs from an end-user perspective to identify usability issues and edge cases early.

  • Foster knowledge sharing and collaboration with the wider QA community at ZEAL to exchange practices, tools and learnings.

  • Work closely with engineers, Product, UX and backend teams to identify risks early, improve testability and build quality into the development process

What you offer us:

  • Strong software engineering skills and experience in quality engineering, test automation, SDET or a comparable engineering-focused role.

  • Strong hands-on experience with TypeScript or JavaScript and the ability to contribute production-quality code directly to a modern web application.

  • Experience designing and building test frameworks, tooling, harnesses, fixtures and automation infrastructure rather than only writing individual test cases

  • Strong experience with Playwright, Cypress or a similar modern end-to-end testing framework.

  • Good understanding of APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD pipelines and applications that integrate with multiple backend services

What we offer:

  • State-of-the-art technologies and an agile environment (Check our Tech Radar: https://lotto24.github.io/tech-radar/)

  • A modern, dynamic culture grounded in the success of a leading-edge e-commerce company.

  • A talented team of ambitious, like-minded colleagues where your knowledge and ideas truly make an impact.

  • Ongoing personal growth, supported by an annual development budget of €1,500 to invest in your professional development.

  • Trust and autonomy, no micromanagement, just confidence in your ability to deliver and excel.

  • Flexible work options with a hybrid setup focused on results.

  • Unlimited vacation days in addition to your yearly 30-day vacation allowance.

  • Opportunity for workations abroad using our WorkFlex tool.

  • Monthly mobility allowance of €30 to use on the mobility option of your choice (e.g., the Deutschlandticket), plus access to a company bike leasing program.

  • Company pension scheme, provided in partnership with Degura, to support your future financial security.

  • Subsidized EGYM WELLPASS membership, with a contribution of only €25 per month, giving you access to a wide range of gyms and sports options across Germany.

  • Quarterly company events, along with regular team activities and informal gatherings, a favorite being our Healthy Tuesday lunches or Treat Thursdays in the office!

 

Sounds exciting? Great! We're looking forward to receiving your online application.

title: Technical Outsource Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Technical Outsource Manager (m/w/d) in Berlin.

Unser Team bietet eine einzigartige Gelegenheit für einen Technischen Outsourcing-Manager (m/w/d), der als Vermittler zwischen unserem High-Tech-Kunden und den Remote-Teams in Bulgarien fungieren wird. Als Technischer Outsourcing-Manager schaffen, pflegen und erweitern Sie Geschäftsbeziehungen, indem Sie langfristige Beziehungen zu unseren Kunden aufbauen und verwalten. Sie fungieren als Bindeglied zwischen dem Kunden und dem Team in Bulgarien und unterstützen diese mit Ihrem technischen Wissen und umfassenden Erfahrungen. Als vertrauenswürdiger Partner werden Sie neue Leads managen und diese zu Nearshoring-Projekten entwickeln; Engineering-Anfragen diskutieren und Einblicke aus verschiedenen Kundenabteilungen einbringen.

Sie werden den Kunden regelmäßig besuchen. Sie sind für Kundenbeziehungen verantwortlich und der Hauptansprechpartner für unsere Kunden bei den betreffenden Projekten in einem komplexen, anspruchsvollen und sich häufig ändernden Umfeld. Sie haben ein Auge dafür, Abweichungen in Qualität, Lieferzeit und Budget zu erkennen, diese anzusprechen und zu managen. Um das Bewusstsein für die Bedürfnisse der Kunden zu schaffen, bringen Sie diese „Signale“ und das Kundenfeedback in das Team ein. Sie gewährleisten eine bidirektionale Kommunikation und managen Eskalationen vom Team in Sofia zum Kunden. Ihre Erfahrung bringt Verantwortung und Eigenverantwortung in die Projekte, was sicherstellt, dass unsere Lösungen nachhaltig und umfassend in die Organisationen unserer Kunden eingebettet sind.

Zusätzliche Verantwortung:

  • Kommunikation mit Kunden auf mehreren Ebenen; mit technischen Spezialisten, Projektmanagern, Fachleitern und zugewiesenem Personal, das in die Projekte involviert ist
  • Teilnahme an Vor-Ort-Meetings mit dem Kunden
  • Abstimmung der Anforderungen (funktional und technisch), Projektplanung, Nachverfolgung und Berichterstattung
  • Technische Beratung in Ihrem Fachgebiet
  • Fungieren als (technische) Schnittstelle zwischen dem Kunden und den Remote-Entwicklungsteams
  • Mitwirkung an der Erstellung und Abstimmung der (langfristigen) Outsourcing-Produkt-Roadmap/Vision mit relevanten Stakeholdern
  • Schließen von Lücken, die durch Nearshoring entstehen, und Entwicklung struktureller Lösungen
  • Erstellung von Budgets für Ingenieurvorschläge
  • Initiierung von Folgeprojektverkäufen und Verwaltung zusätzlicher Budgets
  • Identifizierung neuer Leads in Ihrem Tätigkeitsbereich
  • Entwicklung Ihres Wissens, um ein voll engagiertes und respektiertes Teammitglied zu werden

Fähigkeiten:
Konzeptionelles Denken und die Fähigkeit, die Auswirkungen zu analysieren, (High-Level) Designs zu erstellen, die Arbeit geplanter Funktionen vorzubereiten und herunterzubrechen
Regelmäßige Abstimmung mit dem Kunden über Prioritäten, Umfang und Abhängigkeiten (zwischen Softwareteams)

Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen:

  • Master- oder Bachelor-Abschluss in einem technischen Bereich
  • Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten über Funktionen und Teams hinweg, sowohl nach oben als auch nach unten in der Befehlskette
  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement
  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Softwareentwicklungsumgebung (z.B. als Softwarearchitekt und/oder Softwareingenieur)
  • Tiefgehende Erfahrung im Entwurf und Schreiben von Software
  • Erfahrung in der Leitung von SCRUM-basierten Projekten
  • Erfahrung mit SAFe ist von Vorteil
  • Erfahrung mit Outsourcing ist von Vorteil
  • Erfahrung in einem High-Tech-Embedded-Umfeld ist von Vorteil
  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe, um mit dem Kunden und dem technischen Team auf Augenhöhe zu arbeiten
  • Starke Verhandlungsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, proaktiv mit Konflikten und Eskalationsmethoden umzugehen
  • Sprachniveau: Deutsch C1, Englisch B2

Sie sind:

  • Ein hochmotivierter Selbststarter mit einer Leidenschaft, Ergebnisse zu erzielen
  • Ein Teamplayer
  • In der Lage, häufig vor Ort beim Kunden zu arbeiten
  • Bereit, regelmäßig nach Bulgarien zu reisen

Wir bieten:

  • Eine herausfordernde Position in einem High-Tech-Umfeld mit hoher Kundenintimität, basierend auf einer langfristigen Beziehung
  • Betriebsrente
  • Mobilitätskonzept (wähle zum Beispiel zwischen Tankgutschein, Deutschlandticket, Rollernutzung und anderen Möglichkeiten)
  • Monatliche Company Days für fachlichen und persönlichen Austausch
  • Regelmäßige Team Events
  • Buddy Programm (dein persönlicher Buddy steht dir während des gesamten Onboardings zur Seite. Er ist deine Bezugsperson und soziales Bindeglied zum Unternehmen)
  • Individueller Fortbildungs- und Entwicklungsplan
  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Softdrinks & Feierabendbier gehen auf uns! Wasser und Kaffee gibt es aber natürlich auch ;)

Über uns
Als Teil der niederländischen ICT Group, trägt ICT Digital Solutions seinen Teil dazu bei, die Welt jeden Tag ein bisschen smarter zu machen. Die ICT Group verteilt sich auf 14 Standorte in unterschiedlichen Ländern mit mehr als 2.500 Mitarbeitern.

description:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Harvey is the AI platform trusted by the world's leading law firms and corporate legal teams, and one of the fastest-growing companies in AI. Now we're bringing that to asset management — and this role owns it. We're building the team that will define how the world's leading asset managers, private equity firms, and institutional funds adopt AI. This is a ground-floor opportunity to own a new vertical — we're still proving out this motion, which means the person who joins will help write the playbook.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and manage a named account list across asset management — private equity, venture, private credit, hedge funds, real assets, and institutional allocators (LPs) — and own the full sales cycle from prospecting through contracting and expansion.

  • Build and manage senior relationships across each firm's legal, compliance, and investment teams — typically anchored by a GC, CLO, or CCO — expanding into portfolio-company counsel over time. Understand how decisions get made in these organizations and navigate accordingly.

  • Lead complex, multi-threaded deals with stakeholders ranging from managing directors and general partners to day-to-day legal and compliance users — translating Harvey's AI capabilities into language that resonates with financial buyers.

  • Work closely with product and engineering to stay current on Harvey's capabilities and shape solutions around how asset managers actually work — contract review, due diligence, portfolio company support, regulatory workflows.

  • Conduct tailored demos and presentations that connect Harvey's product directly to the workflows and pain points specific to financial services buyers.

  • Document what works. This team is building the asset management playbook from scratch, and your learnings will directly shape how we scale the motion.


What You Have

  • Experience selling complex software or professional services into financial services (ideally asset management, private equity, or institutional funds). You understand how these firms are structured and how buying decisions get made.

  • Proven ability to run a global or named account relationship — you've been the person a firm calls, not just the person who closes a deal and moves on. Ideally you've navigated a fund relationship or portfolio company motion.

  • Background in enterprise software sales, management consulting, or a combination — we're intentionally mixing profiles on this team. If you've unlocked a major financial services account or come from a firm that advises these organizations, we want to talk to you.

  • Comfortable operating in a motion that's still being defined. You're a builder who can prospect independently, iterate on messaging, and contribute to the team's collective learning.

  • Genuine curiosity about AI and how it applies to knowledge-intensive work. You don't need a legal background, but you should be excited about what Harvey is doing and motivated to develop real fluency in the space.

description:

We are looking for an Avionics Systems Engineer (Flight Computer System) to support the design, development, integration, and validation of spacecraft avionics systems. The role entails delivering robust and reliable electronic systems for data handling, communications, and control across all mission phases.

The engineer will contribute to system architecture definition, interface management, verification activities, and requirements engineering, while working closely with multidisciplinary teams and external stakeholders. In this role, you will be focused on the Flight Computing system of the spacecraft, but you might also be assigned to different avionics systems.

System Design & Architecture

  • Define and develop avionics system architectures, including electronics, data handling, and communication functions.

  • Define computing requirements for processing capability, memory, storage, timing, synchronization, boot and initialization, and operational modes.

  • Develop architectural concepts for fault detection, isolation, and recovery (FDIR), fault containment, redundancy management, and autonomous spacecraft operations.

  • Develop network topology, interface control documents (ICDs), data flow diagrams, communication matrices, and interface specifications.

Communications & Data Handling

Integration & Interface Management

  • Coordinate interface definitions with internal teams, suppliers, and external stakeholders.

External Regulatory & Certification Leadership

Strong ability to technically present, defend, and substantiate avionics subsystem designs and verification evidence with external regulatory and certification authorities, including NASA, ESA, and other government agencies, supporting spacecraft qualification, safety, and flight certification.

Verification & Validation

  • Define and support verification and validation strategies for avionics systems.

  • Participate in simulation, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), and system-level testing activities.

  • Analyze test results, identify anomalies, and drive corrective actions.

  • Ensure compliance with system performance and reliability requirements.

Requirements Engineering

  • Capture, analyze, and manage system and subsystem requirements.

  • Contribute to system documentation, including specifications, interface control documents, and test plans.

  • Ensure compliance with applicable space standards and engineering best practices.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Participate in design reviews, technical exchanges, and system trade-off discussions.

  • Support alignment with external partners, suppliers, and customers.

  • Contribute to integration campaigns, launch preparation, and mission operations support.

Required Qualifications

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or equivalent.

  • 5+ years experience in avionics systems, electronics, embedded systems, or spacecraft engineering.

  • Strong understanding of:

    • Electronic and embedded system architectures

    • Communication and data handling principles

    • System integration and interface management

  • Experience with requirements engineering and system lifecycle development.

  • Knowledge of verification and validation methods, including testing and simulation.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to safety-critical or mission-critical system development.
