Caspar Health builds digital rehabilitation products that enable patients to continue their therapy beyond the clinic and help therapists support them more efficiently.

As a Senior Fullstack Engineer in our Healthcare Professionals Squad, you will build and improve the interface therapists use to manage their daily work. Working across our Ruby on Rails backend and React and TypeScript frontend, you will shape solutions with Product and Design and take them from an initial problem through to production.

You will join a cross-functional team of four engineers and a UX/UI Designer. Together, you will improve how healthcare professionals communicate with patients and deliver therapy—while shaping the architecture, reliability and maintainability of the underlying software.

We appreciate your expertise and wish to provide full transparency regarding the compensation range for this role. Your starting salary will be aligned with your qualifications, relevant experience, skill set, and market benchmarks. Remuneration for this position follows our internal salary bands and ranges from €76,000 to €82,000 gross annually (based on a full-time 40-hour work week).

This role is located in Germany and requires full physical presence within the country. Due to our existing payroll and social security framework, permanent remote employment from abroad is not supported. Candidates must be eligible to work in Germany and resident from their first day. Please be advised that we cannot offer visa sponsorship or relocation assistance at this time.

Deine Herausforderungen

In this role, you will:

  • Learn the workflows supported by our therapist interface, become familiar with our architecture and ship your first improvements during your first three months
  • Take ownership of larger full-stack features—from shaping requirements with Product and Design to implementation, testing, release and iteration
  • Build and improve features across our Ruby on Rails backend and React and TypeScript frontend
  • Make technical implementation decisions about code structure, testing approaches and incremental refactoring
  • Decide how to break down and deliver work within agreed priorities and engineering standards
  • Lead technical recommendations for changes affecting shared architecture, other teams or delivery commitments
  • Improve the therapist experience as well as the reliability and maintainability of the underlying software

Dein Profil

  • Several years of experience building and operating web applications in production
  • Strong experience with Ruby on Rails and experience with React and modern TypeScript

  • The ability to navigate ambiguous requirements, make sound technical trade-offs and turn problems into maintainable solutions
  • A product mindset: you seek to understand the intended outcome rather than treating implementation as an isolated task
  • The judgement and independence to take work from an initial problem through to a production result
  • Professional working proficiency in English

You do not need to meet every requirement perfectly. If the role interests you and you believe your experience could help us improve the platform, we encourage you to apply.

Warum Caspar Health?

title: Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Angefangen hat alles vor sieben Jahren als ambitionierte Idee. Heute sind wir Marktführer für Abschlusszeitungen in Deutschland. Jedes Jahr nutzen mehr als zwei Drittel aller deutschen Abschlussjahrgänge die nuggit App, um ihre Abschlusszeitung und ihre Abschlusstextilien zu gestalten und sich damit eine Erinnerung an eine gemeinsame Zeit zu schaffen, die bleibt.

Unsere Mission: Durch digitale Innovation und persönlichen Kundenkontakt sind wir für SchülerInnen der verlässliche Partner bei ihrem allerersten großen Projekt. Dafür hinterfragen wir permanent den Status Quo und entwickeln neue, kreative Lösungen.

Wir sind ein kleines Team mit sehr großer Reichweite. Als Customer Success Manager (m/w/d) bist du die persönliche Ansprechperson für unsere Abschlussjahrgänge, von der Angebotsannahme bis zur Lieferung. Standardfragen beantworten bei uns Chatbot und Helpcenter, das Onboarding läuft über Videos und Formulare. Du kümmerst dich um das, was Automatisierung nicht kann: echte Beziehungen zu den Jahrgängen aufbauen und dafür sorgen, dass jedes Projekt sicher ins Ziel kommt. Das heißt kurze Wege, direkte Wirkung und viel Verantwortung. Es heißt aber auch, dass du eigenständig arbeiten und priorisieren musst.

Aufgaben

  • Betreuung: Du betreust unsere Jahrgänge per Videocall, Chat und Telefon und bist für alles da, was über Chatbot und Helpcenter hinausgeht.

  • Projektbegleitung: Du begleitest jeden Jahrgang von der Angebotsannahme bis zur Lieferung, behältst Fristen und Freigaben im Blick und fasst nach, wenn ein Projekt hängt. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem Operations-Team zusammen, das Produktion und Lieferung steuert.

  • Pipeline: Du hast deine Kunden eigenständig im Griff: Status, nächste Schritte, Risiken. Wo es eng wird, merkst du es vor dem Kunden.

  • Video-Sprechstunden: Wir bauen buchbare Video-Calls auf, in denen SchülerInnen intensive Begleitung bei ihrem Projekt bekommen. Du gestaltest das Format mit und führst die Calls.

  • Self-Service: Du erkennst, welche Fragen immer wiederkommen, und sorgst dafür, dass Chatbot und Helpcenter sie künftig beantworten.

  • Wachstum: Wenn du Lust hast, wächst du in Upselling und Referral hinein: Textilien für Jahrbuch-Kunden, Jahrbuch für Textil-Kunden, Schulshops und Empfehlungen an andere Jahrgänge und Schulen.

So arbeiten wir

  • Persönlich ist unser Unterschied. Unsere Kunden sind 17, 18 oder 19 Jahre alt und stemmen oft ihr erstes großes Projekt. Sie brauchen jemanden, der erreichbar ist, mitdenkt und ehrlich sagt, wenn es eng wird.

  • Automatisierung entlastet dich, sie ersetzt dich nicht. Chatbot, Helpcenter und Onboarding-Videos nehmen dir die Standardfragen ab, damit du Zeit für die Gespräche hast, die wirklich zählen.

  • Eigeninitiative ist Pflicht, nicht Bonus. Du bekommst Ziele und Kontext, den Weg gestaltest du selbst. Niemand treibt dich an, aber alle verlassen sich auf dich.

  • Hybrid, ehrlich gemeint. Unser neues Office liegt im Mindspace in der Uhlandstraße 32, direkt am Kudamm und bestens angebunden, mit allen Annehmlichkeiten eines Coworking Space. Alle weiteren Mindspace Standorte kannst du temporär mitnutzen. Homeoffice und mobiles Arbeiten sind selbstverständlich möglich, solange das Ergebnis stimmt.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Kundenservice, Support oder Customer Success gesammelt. Wie lange, interessiert uns weniger als das, was du daraus mitnimmst.

  • Du kannst mit jungen Menschen: locker im Ton, verbindlich in der Sache.

  • Telefon und Kamera schrecken dich nicht ab, im Gegenteil.

  • Du organisierst dich selbst und behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Projekten den Überblick.

  • Du lieferst zuverlässig, auch wenn viel gleichzeitig läuft. Unsere Saison hat klare Peaks.

  • Du arbeitest sicher mit CRM-Tools und digitalen Kanälen.

  • Du erkennst, wenn ein Kunde mehr braucht, und sprichst es an. Vertriebserfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch. Das ist bei uns Voraussetzung, weil unsere Kunden deutschsprachig sind.

  • Du hast eine proaktive Haltung und arbeitest gerne eng mit anderen Teams zusammen.

Benefits

Unser Angebot

  • Du begleitest jedes Jahr Abschlussjahrgänge aus ganz Deutschland bei ihrem allerersten großen Projekt

  • Eine Rolle mit Perspektive: vom Support hin zu echtem Customer Success mit Upselling und Referral

  • Ein kleines Team, in dem deine Arbeit direkt sichtbar ist

  • Kurze Wege und offene Ohren: Ideen landen bei uns direkt beim Entscheider, ohne Zwischenebenen

  • 30 Urlaubstage, Firmenlaptop, Sachgutscheine sowie D-Ticket oder JobRad

Die perfekte Bewerberin oder den perfekten Bewerber gibt es nicht. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung, auch wenn du die Anforderungen (noch) nicht zu 100 % erfüllst, du aber die Motivation mitbringst, dir die nötigen Fähigkeiten anzueignen. Wir begrüßen BewerberInnen verschiedenster Hintergründe, ungeachtet ihrer Geschlechtsidentität, Religion, Ethnizität, nationaler Herkunft, sexuellen Orientierung, Migrationsgeschichte, Alter oder Einschränkungen.

title: Business Development Representative (m/w/d) - AI Agent Platform
description:
Ninox ist eine Berliner Low-Code-Plattform, mit der Teams genau die Geschäftsanwendungen bauen, die sie brauchen. Rund 80 Mitarbeitende, tausende Kundinnen und Kunden in ganz Europa, vom kleinen Team bis zum Großunternehmen. Ein Produkt, an dem Menschen wirklich hängen. Wir sind seit 12 Jahren am Markt, etabliert, wachsen und sind solide mit Wagniskapital finanziert.

Worum es geht

Du machst Outbound. Zu 100 %, und vor allem am Telefon.

Du bekommst Zielaccounts aus Branchen, die wir vorab festlegen, findest dort die Menschen, die das Problem tatsächlich haben, rufst sie an — und buchst qualifizierte Erstgespräche für unsere Account Executives. Nach dem Handover übernimmt der AE. Dein Ergebnis ist das stattgefundene, qualifizierte Gespräch, nicht der Abschluss und nicht der Kalendereintrag.

Der größte Teil unseres Geschäfts sind kleine und mittlere Unternehmen, dazu kommt ein solider Anteil Mid-Market. Innerhalb der Verticals, die für uns nachweislich funktionieren, gehen wir gelegentlich auch in größere Organisationen. Damit es keine Missverständnisse gibt: „Enterprise" heißt bei uns Unternehmen mit einigen hundert bis wenigen tausend Mitarbeitenden — nicht DAX-Konzern mit zweijährigem Beschaffungsprozess und Rahmenvertragsverhandlung.

Du arbeitest auf Deutsch und auf Englisch, jeden Tag. Deutschland und Großbritannien sind unsere Kernmärkte, weitere europäische Länder kommen situativ dazu.

Dein Umfeld, ehrlich beschrieben: Unser Vertrieb arbeitet heute Full-Funnel. Die Account Executives machen neben allem anderen rund eine Stunde Outbound pro Tag. Dazu kommt eine Kollegin bzw. ein Kollege mit ebenfalls reinem Outbound-Fokus, allerdings auf Kooperationen, Webinare und Partner. Du bist damit die erste Person bei uns, die ausschließlich und direkt auf Neukunden-Erstgespräche geht. Das heißt: Es gibt Erfahrung im Haus, an die du andocken kannst, und ein Playbook, das gerade entsteht. Welche Branchen wir angehen und mit welchen Kampagnen, verantworten unser Head of Sales und unser CRO. Dein Part ist das Gespräch, und was du dort hörst, fließt direkt in die nächste Runde ein.

Aufgaben

  • Telefon ist dein Hauptkanal. Cold Calling ist der Kern der Rolle, nicht ein Kanal unter mehreren. E-Mail und LinkedIn ergänzen die Ansprache

  • Ziellisten aus den Verticals abarbeiten, die Head of Sales und CRO festlegen. Die Listen kommen aufgebaut aus Clay und Cognism. Du priorisierst innerhalb der Liste und bereitest jeden Account kurz vor, bevor du anrufst

  • Kampagnen und Sequenzen in Lemlist setzen Head of Sales und CRO auf. Du führst sie aus und passt deinen Gesprächseinstieg im Call an dein Gegenüber an. Lemlist ist dein täglicher Arbeitsplatz, Clay und Cognism füttern ihn

  • Erstgespräche buchen, sauber vorbereiten und mit belastbarem Kontext an die Account Executives übergeben

  • Zurückspielen, was du im Markt hörst: welche Branche reagiert, welche Botschaft funktioniert, welche Einwände wiederkehren. Marketing und Sales-Leitung brauchen das

  • HubSpot sauber und aktuell halten — nicht als Selbstzweck, sondern weil Pipeline-Bewertung und Forecast darauf beruhen.

  • Enge Abstimmung mit Marketing und den AEs zu Kampagnen und Übergabekriterien

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 1,5 Jahre Outbound-Erfahrung im B2B, idealerweise SaaS oder erklärungsbedürftige IT-Lösungen. Du musst nicht alles gesehen haben, aber du solltest den Job kennen und nicht bei null anfangen — ein spürbarer Teil dieser Zeit sollte am Telefon stattgefunden haben und nicht nur in Sequenzen. Das ist keine Einstiegsposition.

  • Deutsch verhandlungssicher auf muttersprachnahem Niveau (C2), Englisch mindestens C1. Beides täglich. Der Maßstab ist das Telefonat: Du führst auf Englisch ein Kaltgespräch, reagierst auf Einwände und hältst den Small Talk davor und danach aus, ohne dass die Sprache zum Thema wird. Wir hören uns das im Prozess an.

  • Du kannst nachvollziehbar erklären, warum deine Ansprache funktioniert hat — mit Zahlen und mit einer Begründung, nicht mit Bauchgefühl.

  • Du kommst mit Geschäftsführerinnen und Inhabern zurecht. Im Mittelstand hast du häufig direkt die Person am Telefon, die entscheidet — und die dir drei Minuten gibt, bevor sie wieder in den Betrieb muss. Erst in größeren Häusern sprichst du mit Fachbereichsleitungen und gelegentlich mit der IT.

  • Recherchefähigkeit: Du findest heraus, wer in einem Unternehmen ein Problem hat, bevor du zum Hörer greifst.

  • Selbstorganisation: Du strukturierst deine Woche selbst und brauchst keine tägliche Ansage, um in die Aktivität zu kommen.

  • Ein realistisches Verhältnis zu Ablehnung. Der größte Teil deiner Versuche führt zu nichts. Das ist normal und sollte dich weder überraschen noch aus der Ruhe bringen.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit CRM und Sales-Engagement-Tools. Unser Stack ist HubSpot, Lemlist, Clay und Cognism — genau diese Tools musst du nicht kennen, vergleichbare schon.

  • Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit KI-Tools. Recherche verdichten, Textvarianten durchspielen, ein Unternehmen vor dem Call in fünf Minuten verstehen — das geht heute schneller, wenn man weiß wie. Wir erwarten keine Zertifikate, aber auch niemanden, der ChatGPT einmal ausprobiert und wieder weggelegt hat.

  • Von Vorteil: Du hast schon aktiv nach Großbritannien akquiriert und kennst den Unterschied im Gesprächseinstieg. Ebenfalls hilfreich: Erfahrung mit Low-Code/No-Code-, ERP-, CRM- oder Datenbankthemen.

Formale Abschlüsse sind uns weniger wichtig als belastbare Outbound-Praxis. Wenn du das kannst, interessiert uns dein Studienfach nicht.

Benefits

Was wir bieten

  • 60.000 – 70.000 € Zieljahresgehalt (OTE) bei einem Split von 70 % Fixum und 30 % variabel. Der variable Anteil hängt an Kriterien, die du beeinflussen kannst, und ist erreichbar geplant. Den Plan legen wir vor Vertragsunterschrift offen.

  • Strukturierter Einstieg: Produkt, ICP, Einwände und Gesprächsleitfäden in den ersten Wochen — plus regelmäßige 1:1s und Call-Reviews statt Zurufmanagement.

  • Kurze Wege. Du berichtest an Tim Genkinger, unseren Head of Sales, und hast direkten Zugang zu den Menschen, die über Produkt und Go-to-Market entscheiden.

  • 30 Urlaubstage, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, BVG-Ticket und weitere Benefits.

  • Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro am Monbijouplatz in Berlin-Mitte.

  • Ein Stack, der die Arbeit tatsächlich trägt: HubSpot als CRM, Lemlist für Sequenzen, Clay für Listenaufbau und Anreicherung, Cognism für belastbare Telefonnummern. Dazu KI-Assistenz als fester Teil des Arbeitsalltags, bei uns Claude, für Recherche, Textvarianten und Call-Vorbereitung. Du verbringst deine Zeit mit Gesprächen und nicht mit der Suche nach Durchwahlen. Fehlt im Stack etwas, reden wir darüber.

  • Ein Unternehmen, klein genug, dass deine Ergebnisse sichtbar sind, und groß genug, dass sie etwas bewegen.

Was diese Rolle nicht ist

  • Kein Inbound. Anfragen aus Produkt und Marketing laufen an anderer Stelle. Es gibt keine eingehenden Leads und keine Messelisten zum Nachfassen.

  • Kein Closing. Angebot, Verhandlung und Abschluss liegen bei den AEs. Die Stelle ist als Outbound-Rolle ausgeschrieben, nicht als Durchgangsstation — wohin es danach geht, entscheidet sich über Ergebnisse und nicht über eine Zusage im Bewerbungsgespräch.

  • Keine Führungsrolle. Du baust kein Team auf und führst niemanden.

  • Keine reine Remote-Rolle. Wir hätten dich gern etwa zwei Tage pro Woche im Büro, im Haus sind das meist Dienstag bis Donnerstag. Mehr ist willkommen, weniger im Einzelfall auch machbar. Berlin als Lebensmittelpunkt setzen wir voraus.

  • Kein Produkt, das sich von selbst erklärt. Ninox ist keine Wissenschaft — in einer Demo versteht fast jeder, was es tut. Der Aufhänger liegt trotzdem nie im Produkt, sondern beim Gegenüber: das Excel-Konstrukt, das niemand mehr pflegen kann, die Standardsoftware, die nicht passt. Darauf musst du Lust haben.

Bewerbung

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze zu einer Ansprache, die funktioniert hat: wen du angesprochen hast, warum genau so, was dabei herauskam und was du daraus für den nächsten Versuch mitgenommen hast. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

Unser Prozess besteht aus drei Terminen:

  1. Erstgespräch mit Tim Genkinger, Head of Sales und Hiring Manager dieser Rolle.

  2. Case Study. Du bekommst vorab eine Aufgabe und stellst sie Tim und Michael Blazek, unserem CRO, vor. Teile davon führen wir auf Englisch.

  3. Meet the Team. Du lernst die Kolleginnen und Kollegen kennen, mit denen du täglich arbeiten wirst.

Danach entscheiden wir. Wir halten den Prozess bewusst kurz und melden uns bei jeder Bewerbung zurück, auch bei einer Absage.

Ninox steht für ein Arbeitsumfeld ohne Diskriminierung. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht, Alter, Religion, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität.

What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.

Who We Need

We are building industry-defining accounting and finance software. We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Accounting Solutions Consultant to join our team and help lead the successful onboarding of new customers onto Rillet.

This role is ideal for someone with a strong accounting foundation who is excited to work directly with customers and help finance teams modernize how they operate. You may come from Big 4 audit, accounting advisory, finance transformation, or an operational accounting role at a high-growth technology company. You do not need to have formally led ERP implementations before, but you do need to be systems-minded, highly organized, customer-oriented, and eager to learn quickly in a fast-paced startup environment.

We’re primarily looking for teammates who are based near our New York City or San Francisco offices, or open to relocating. For this role, we’re also open to remote candidates based anywhere in the United States. Our hybrid schedule brings office-based team members together in person on Tuesdays and Thursdays, plus one additional flexible day each week. Some roles may spend more time in the office depending on the needs of the team.

What You'll Do

  • Lead key parts of customer onboarding and deployment, helping ensure a smooth and timely implementation experience

  • Partner with internal teams across Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to execute implementation plans and solve customer problems quickly

  • Learn and analyze client accounting and finance workflows, then translate those needs into clear requirements and practical solutions

  • Guide customers through onboarding, training, change management, and adoption

  • Support data migration, reconciliations, systems setup, and integration coordination

  • Track milestones, drive follow-through, and keep internal and external stakeholders aligned throughout the onboarding process

  • Identify risks early, escalate issues quickly, and help keep customer launches on track

  • Build trust with customers by being responsive, thoughtful, and solutions-oriented

  • Maintain clear documentation and provide regular status updates to customers and internal stakeholders

Who We're Looking For

  • 4-7 years of experience in accounting, audit, advisory, or related customer-facing roles

  • Strong accounting foundation, with the ability to speak credibly about close, reconciliations, revenue recognition (ASC 606), and core finance workflows

  • Excellent communication skills and the presence to work directly with customers and senior stakeholders

  • Systems-minded and excited to learn implementation work, even if you have not formally held an implementation title before

  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams at once

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high attention to detail

  • Experience working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams

  • Experience in Big 4, SaaS or at a technology company is a plus

The expected base salary range for this role varies by location:

Tier A: $100,000 – $150,000

Your compensation tier is based on your primary work location. You can view Rillet’s compensation zones here.

Final compensation within the applicable range will depend on factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and the scope of the role. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits.

 

Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam.

Life at Rillet

  • Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.

  • Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.

  • Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.

Compensation: $100K – $150K • Offers Equity

title: Senior RAMS Engineer
description:
We are looking for a RAMS Engineer to strengthen our safety and compliance team, with a particular emphasis on safety engineering for our vehicles, propulsion systems, ground infrastructure, and operations.

RAMS covers Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, and Safety. This role will apply those principles across the full lifecycle of complex hardware and operational systems, helping ensure that hazards are identified early, risks are controlled, and safety requirements are supported by clear technical evidence.

Although the role sits within safety and compliance rather than systems engineering, you will need a strong systems-engineering background and experience working with high-reliability, high-safety, or mission-critical systems.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Establish and develop RAMS and safety-engineering processes across vehicles, propulsion systems, ground systems, facilities, and operations.

  • Define, manage, and verify reliability, availability, maintainability, and safety requirements throughout the system lifecycle.

  • Lead hazard identification, risk assessments, failure-mode analysis, fault-tree analysis, and other structured safety assessments.

  • Develop and maintain safety cases, hazard logs, RAMS plans, safety assessments, compliance evidence, and technical justifications.

  • Work with systems, propulsion, avionics, test, manufacturing, operations, and suppliers to identify hazards and implement effective risk controls.

  • Support design reviews, test-readiness reviews, operational-readiness activities, incident investigations, change control, and corrective actions.

What we are looking for

  • Proven experience in RAMS, safety engineering, reliability engineering, or systems engineering for high-reliability, high-safety, or mission-critical systems.

  • Experience analysing complex hardware and operational systems, including interfaces, failure modes, hazards, and system-level risks.

  • Strong understanding of safety-engineering methods and the ability to turn analysis into practical design and operational controls.

  • Experience producing clear technical documentation, safety arguments, risk assessments, compliance evidence, and engineering reports.

  • Strong communication skills, with the confidence to challenge technical decisions and work effectively with specialist engineering and operational teams.

  • A degree in systems engineering, safety engineering, aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience may also be relevant.

Desirable experience

  • RAMS or safety engineering within aerospace, space, defence, rocketry, missile systems, nuclear, rail, energy, automotive, or another high-consequence industry.

  • Experience with FMEA, FMECA, fault-tree analysis, hazard analysis, HAZOP, STPA, bow-tie analysis, or similar techniques.

  • Safety cases, functional-safety assessments, reliability predictions, maintainability analysis, or probabilistic risk assessment.

  • Propulsion systems, solid rocket motors, hazardous materials, explosives, test stands, launch operations, or high-energy systems.

  • Experience supporting verification and validation, qualification, acceptance testing, configuration control, and engineering change processes.

  • Familiarity with applicable aerospace, defence, functional-safety, quality, or hazardous-operations standards and regulatory frameworks.

  • Fluent German would be a significant advantage in this position.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

Please submit applications in English

title: Operations Manager (m/f/d)
description:
About ALPAMI

At ALPAMI we're building a boutique hospitality brand. ALPAMI operates 200+ keys across the Black Forest, Switzerland, Tirol, and Munich — spanning City Boutique Houses, Tiny Houses in Nature, and Properties as a Service. We're not chasing stars; we're chasing 5-star experiences delivered in our own, unmistakably boutique way.

We're bootstrapped, founder-led, and growing fast — with a clear target of 500 units next year. That means the operational engine behind our guest experience needs to scale just as fast, and that's exactly where you come in.

The Role

We're looking for an Operations Manager who reports directly to the MD and, from our Munich HQ, keeps the operational engine behind our guest experience running: you make sure our Customer Care team always has the relevant information at hand, support them in guest communication, and steer our local stakeholders on site. You are the nerve center of ALPAMI's day-to-day: the person who sees every property, every process, and every issue before it becomes a problem — and who fixes it before the guest even notices.

This is not a job for someone who wants a quiet 9-to-5. We're a fast-growing, founder-led company, and we need someone who understands what that actually means in practice: unpredictable days, fast decisions, and a genuine sense of ownership over the outcome. We expect high reachability, hospitality is a 365 day business. If you don’t agree with that, this might not be the right choice for you.

What You'll Do

  • Own operations end-to-end — surveil and continuously improve operational processes and management standards across our entire portfolio of properties

  • Be the single point of contact for our Customer Care team, provide them with relevant, up-to-date property information (access details, house rules, local specifics, open issues) so every guest gets a fast and correct answer

  • Assist with guest communication — step in on complex requests, special cases, and escalations, and help keep our tone and response times consistently on brand

  • Steer our local stakeholders on site — make sure the guest journey is smooth at every locationMonitor and act on operating room KPIs — occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, guest satisfaction scores, response SLAs, and the other numbers that tell you where to focus next

  • Carry out on-site visits in coordination with our Operations Lead whenever quality checks, partner onboarding, training, or problem-solving require an on-the-ground presence

  • Prioritize ruthlessly — you always know what needs fixing right now versus what can wait, and you make that call fast

  • Solve issues immediately — you're hands-on by nature and would rather fix something yourself in the next ten minutes than schedule a meeting about it next week

  • Lead and develop operational team members as we scale, setting the standard for how ALPAMI runs

  • Champion guest happiness as a non-negotiable core value — every decision you make is filtered through "does this make the guest experience better?"

What You Bring (Must-Haves)

  • 2–5+ years of experience in hospitality operations

  • Bilingual in German and English (spoken and written)

  • Strong written communication skills, clear, warm, and solution-oriented with guests, colleagues, and partners alike

  • A genuine hands-on mentality — you fix things yourself, immediately, rather than escalating by default

  • Strong prioritization skills and the judgment to resolve issues on the spot

  • Stress resistance, you stay clear-headed and effective when multiple things go wrong at once

  • Willingness to travel occasionally for on-site visits to our properties

  • An understanding that joining a fast-growing company means flexible hours and a workload that doesn't always fit neatly into Monday–Friday, 9-to-5

  • Customer happiness as a core personal value, not just a KPI

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience leading a team

  • Experience in guest communication or customer care, ideally in hospitality

  • Deep technical understanding of hospitality tech tools (e.g. PMS, channel managers, guest communication platforms, revenue management systems)

  • Familiarity with AI, you don’t step away in challenge yourself and your workflows with AI

  • A driver's license

  • Experience opening new locations/properties

What We Offer

  • Direct reporting line to the Managing Director — your work has visibility and impact from day one

  • A front-row seat and real influence on our path to 500 units next year — you won't just support our growth, you'll be one of the reasons it happens

  • The autonomy of a founder-led, bootstrapped company: fast decisions, no bureaucracy, real ownership

  • The chance to shape what "operational excellence" means at ALPAMI as we scale

  • A team that believes 5-star experiences aren't about star ratings — they're about how we treat every single guest

  • A fair, competitive salary

  • A nice office in Munich

  • Frequent team events

  • Wellpass membership for your physical and mental well-being

Sound like you? We'd love to hear from you.

employer: How We Work & What We Value - Ashby
description:
Hello!

I'm Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. 👋

As our team has grown, one of the keys to providing exceptional Support is ensuring every new hire can hit the ground running on a product with a lot of depth and nuance. Helping someone move from “just joined” to confidently helping customers takes exceptional care. We pride ourselves on delivering an onboarding experience that helps each person who joins our team be successful and, in turn, help our customers be successful.

Our onboarding program has given new hires a strong foundation. As the team continues to scale and the product keeps evolving, we know there's more to build.

That's why we're looking for one Support Trainer in AMER and one in EMEA to partner with our Training Lead and help take onboarding and ongoing training to the next level.

This role goes beyond running sessions off an existing curriculum. We're looking for someone who can dig into what's working, spot where new hires are still struggling to get up to speed, and turn that insight into better materials and better training. You'll partner closely with our Training Lead to deliver onboarding day to day, while also helping evolve the program as our product and team continue to grow.

If you're energized by joining a strong program and pushing it further, love making complex product knowledge click for new learners, and want to stay close to frontline Support work, this might be the role for you.

About This Role

As the Support Trainer, you'll design, develop, and deliver the training programs that enable the Support team to provide exceptional service. You'll work closely with Support team members and cross-functional partners to build training materials, assess where the team needs support, and ensure everyone stays current on product knowledge and best practices as we grow.

Since this function is central to how our team scales, you'll have the opportunity to build on a strong foundation, strengthen how we onboard and continuously develop our team, and create a culture where growth and knowledge-sharing are part of everyday work.

What You'll Own

Training Program Design and Delivery

  • Deliver and further develop training programs for new Support hires and ongoing team development, covering product knowledge, Support processes, internal tools, and talent acquisition-related processes.

  • Facilitate workshops, one-on-one coaching, and asynchronous learning sessions to help new team members provide a high-quality customer experience.

  • Create clear, engaging, and comprehensive training materials, including guides, videos, and tutorials.

Measuring and Improving Training

  • Collaborate with Support Leadership to assess training needs and create customized learning experiences.

  • Continuously update training materials based on product updates, new features, and feedback from the team.

  • Track the progress of trainees and provide feedback to support continuous improvement.

  • Use trainee-progress and performance data to measure the effectiveness of training initiatives, connect changes to outcomes such as ramp speed, CSAT, and QA scores, and refine the program as needed.

Staying Close to Support

  • Regularly spend time handling Support tickets to maintain continued familiarity with processes and workflows.

  • Use firsthand experience with the work to keep training grounded in what the job actually requires.

Role Requirements

  • Proven experience designing or delivering training programs within a Support or Customer Success organization, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment.

  • Meaningful experience working in Support or another customer-facing technical function.

  • Experience building onboarding programs, facilitating workshops, and coaching individuals through skill development.

  • Ability to connect training outcomes to real performance and customer experience improvements, not just completion rates.

  • Strong ability to translate complex or technical information into clear, engaging, and digestible learning materials.

  • Analytical mindset for identifying skill gaps, spotting trends in performance, and iterating on programs over time.

  • Comfort working in ambiguity and building structure and process where none exists.

  • Passionate about customer experience and the role well-trained Support teams play in creating trust and loyalty.

  • Skilled at delivering constructive, actionable feedback and coaching people toward growth.

  • Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to engage learners across different styles and experience levels.

You Should Apply If:

  • You're excited about iterating on a strong program foundation and thinking creatively about enabling Support on highly technical topics.

  • You thrive on turning complex product and process knowledge into training that's clear, practical, and engaging.

  • You want to stay close to the frontline work you're training people to do, not just design programs from a distance.

  • You're data-driven and want to tie training effectiveness to real performance and customer outcomes.

  • You love coaching people and watching them grow into confident, capable support professionals.

You May Not Want to Apply If:

  • You'd rather focus solely on individual coaching than program design and materials development.

  • You prefer not to spend regular time handling Support tickets to stay connected to the work.

  • You're not interested in balancing program-building with hands-on training delivery.

  • You're uncomfortable iterating on training programs based on feedback and changing product needs.

 

About Ashby

Ashby builds a suite of products that helps talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run their hiring process significantly better. We raised a $50M Series D in July 2025 and support nearly 5,000 customers, including Shopify, Snowflake, OpenAI, Deliveroo, and Confluent. We’re growing much faster than 100% year over year, with a team of roughly 300 people across 22+ countries. Learn more at ashbyhq.com.

About Go To Market

We view our Support team as an extension of the product itself, one that ensures an optimal customer experience for customers ranging across all market segments. Here are a few points that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us:

  • We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is easier to sell.

  • We also spend a lot of time building a best-in-class customer experience. We aim to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers.

  • We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people and the right work environment deliver much better performance than teams with large headcount.

We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication (we put a lot of effort into using the right communication channels) - we’ll get into these and other values during the hiring process. You can take a look at our Leadership Principles to get a sense of what we value in People Leaders at Ashby.

Interview process

Our interview process is thorough and designed to give you enough information to assess whether Ashby is the right fit for you, while helping us evaluate technical reasoning, communication precision, and ownership.

  • Intro call with Recruiting — 30 min

  • Hiring Manager interview — 45–60 min

  • Take-home assessment — 5 days to complete

  • Virtual onsite — 120 min

    • Coaching for Customer Impact — 30 min

    • Measuring Training Systems — 30 min

    • Frontline Support Partnership — 30 min

    • Closing questions — 15 min

Benefits

Benefits vary by country and are shared in more detail during the process. International employees receive statutory benefits and, where available, employer-paid supplemental health coverage.

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅

  • A $1,200 annual learning and professional-development budget.

  • A one-time $2,000 home-office setup budget for furniture, monitors, peripherals, and ergonomic equipment, plus a company-provided laptop.

  • Opportunities to spend time with teammates through an annual company offsite, team offsites, local meetups, and virtual events.

  • Extended health benefits for you and your dependents (subject to availability with our Employer of Record)

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

title: CRM & Revenue Operations Analyst
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a curious, commercially sharp CRM & Revenue Operations Analyst to join our growing RevOps function. This is a dual-natured role: on one side, hands-on CRM administration and data stewardship within a collaborative team; on the other, a broader remit that spans the full commercial journey — from Marketing through Sales to Customer Success — ensuring the processes, tools, and data that connect them are coherent, reliable, and built to support business growth.

You'll work closely with our Revenue Operations Manager, based in Copenhagen, and collaborate with market teams, sales and marketing stakeholders, and internal IT across all 14 markets. This isn't a role for someone who wants to execute instructions in isolation. We want someone who understands the commercial context behind what they're building — and who takes ownership of making sure it actually works for the people using it.

What You'll Do

CRM Administration & Development

– Support the maintenance and ongoing development of our HubSpot CRM in collaboration with the RevOps team — covering data quality, property management, workflow logic, and pipeline integrity across all markets

– Assist in building, testing, and documenting automation workflows, lifecycle stages, and custom data structures

– Act as a reliable point of contact for CRM-related queries from market teams, escalating where needed and closing the loop on issues

Reporting & Market Intelligence

– Build and maintain dashboards and reports in HubSpot to support sales leadership and country managers across all 14 markets

– Translate reporting requests into structured, actionable outputs — not just visualisations, but insights that inform decisions

– Monitor data health proactively and flag inconsistencies before they compound

Revenue Operations — Marketing to Customer Success

– Support the design, documentation, and continuous improvement of processes that span the full commercial funnel — from marketing acquisition through sales pipeline management to customer success handoffs

– Help ensure that tools, data flows, and operational logic work coherently across functions, reducing friction and improving visibility at every stage

– Contribute to ICP qualification frameworks, segmentation models, lead management logic, and pipeline hygiene practices

– Collaborate with internal IT to support integrations between internal systems and the broader commercial toolstack, helping bridge technical and business requirements

Stakeholder Management & Cross-functional Collaboration

– Work alongside sales, marketing, customer success, and IT stakeholders to understand needs, gather requirements, and translate them into operational solutions

– Communicate clearly across functions and markets — managing expectations, flagging dependencies, and keeping the right people informed

– Represent the RevOps function as a reliable, solutions-oriented partner rather than a bottleneck

Training Materials & Process Documentation

– Develop clear, structured training materials covering tools, processes, and operational frameworks — ensuring teams across all markets have what they need to work effectively

– Maintain process and system documentation as a living resource, updated as workflows evolve

– Work across our training infrastructure (including Supered and Sana) to publish and distribute materials to the right audiences

– Identify knowledge gaps through stakeholder engagement and translate them into practical, usable guidance

What We're Looking For

– 1–2 years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, marketing operations, CRM administration, or a closely adjacent role

– Solid working knowledge of CRM systems — HubSpot experience is a significant advantage and will be strongly prioritised

– Analytically capable, with the ability to turn raw data into clear, usable business insights

– Sharp commercial instinct — you understand how operational decisions connect to revenue outcomes across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success

– Comfortable working cross-functionally, including with technical stakeholders such as IT, and translating between business needs and system capabilities

– Detail-oriented and process-driven, without losing sight of the bigger picture

– Excellent written and spoken English; additional languages are a genuine bonus — Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, German, French, Dutch, Portuguese, or Polish

– Proactively curious — you ask questions before you build, and you build things that last

Nice to Have

– Hands-on HubSpot experience beyond basic CRM use — workflows, reporting, custom properties, or integrations

– Familiarity with sales intelligence tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator or Evergrowth

– Experience supporting tool integrations or working alongside IT on system connectivity

– Exposure to multi-market or international business environments

– A track record of creating structured training content or process documentation

– Background in B2B services, IT staffing, or professional consultancy

What We Offer

– A central role in emagine's revenue infrastructure, with genuine cross-market scope from day one

– Direct mentorship from an experienced Revenue Operations Manager with deep HubSpot and systems expertise

– Broad exposure to a modern RevOps toolstack and clear room to grow — technically and strategically

– A hybrid working setup with real autonomy and flexibility, based in one of our office locations across our 14 markets

– The opportunity to grow alongside a function that is actively expanding its influence across the business

We empower companies with high-end IT services

emagine is a high-end business, engineering & IT consulting company. Enabled by an extensive network of experts, emagine powers progress, solves challenges and delivers real results through tailored high-end consulting services. emagine is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with departments in France, Germany, Ireland, the Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Sweden, United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates as well as India. Over the last couple of years, the company has grown extensively, increasing its international footprint to become one of the biggest consultancies in its segment in Europe and beyond. emagine A/S is owned by private equity company Axcel and a group of senior staff and board members.

Are you our new colleague?

At emagine, we value diversity immensely. Both when it comes to backgrounds and competences, but also in relation to personality and individual ambition. We are a diverse and well-rounded group made up of experienced specialists, generalists, recent graduates and self-taught people. We are generally curious, helpful and happy to share knowledge with our colleagues.

We are proud of our values that are based on honesty, kindness, helpfulness and solidarity. We nurture a strong community culture, where cooperation is paramount – not just locally but also across borders with our international departments. Only in unison can we provide the best service to our clients and affiliated consultants – and that is our goal. As an employee of emagine, you will experience a close-knit culture in which people stand side by side and where there is an emphasis on building close relationships. Going to work must be a fun and enriching experience yet still provide a challenge. That is why we take several steps to ensure that work is motivating and engaging. Finally, we also strive to create the right conditions for physical and mental wellbeing.

title: Content Writer
description:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Content Writer to help shape how Paddle shows up in the world. This is a writing role for someone who can take complex product ideas and push the boundaries of B2B content with bold stories, turning product launches, feature releases and customer problems into work people genuinely want to read.

We’re looking for strong storytelling, journalistic instincts and a clear point of view, with the craft to make complicated subjects memorable.


You’ll adapt ideas for different audiences and channels.
You’ll use AI tools thoughtfully while maintaining human judgement, accuracy and originality. You’ll partner with Product, Product Marketing, Communications, Design and subject-matter experts to develop content with a clear point of view.


What you’ll do

  • Develop original, customer-centric editorial and product content across our content ecosystem.

  • Find sharp angles and strong points of view for product stories, launches, campaigns, customer stories and other content.

  • Turn product strategy, customer problems and technical detail into clear narratives that build understanding and adoption.

  • Apply SEO principles without compromising originality, clarity or readability.

  • Use audience insight, search data and performance data to inform content decisions.

  • Adapt strong ideas across formats and channels.

  • Collaborate with Design and cross-functional partners to bring ideas to life, using Figma.

  • Help maintain our TOV, raise Paddle’s editorial standards and writing quality.

We’d love to hear from you if you are

  • An experienced writer, journalist, editor or content specialist with a strong body of published work across a variety of channels.

  • Comfortable writing about tech, business or complex subject, finding the human angle.

  • Skilled at turning product strategy, customer interviews, research and expert input into engaging stories.

  • Comfortable challenging a brief when there is a better story, sharper angle or more useful way to serve the audience.

  • Experienced with SEO fundamentals.

  • Understanding content performance and how it shapes your work.

  • Able to manage multiple briefs and deadlines without losing sight of quality.

  • Confidence to work with AI tools and design platforms, such as Figma.

You do not need to have worked in B2B tech. We’re more interested in your ability to understand complex subjects, ask good questions and challenge the norms of our industry.


What we’re looking for in your portfolio

Please include examples that demonstrate:

  • Must-have: Two pieces that shows range e.g. short-form to long-form

  • Must-have: A customer story, case study or interview-led piece

  • Nice-to-have: An example piece of content as part of a Product launch/activation

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.

 

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We’re a diverse, growing group of Paddlers who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

  • Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us”

  • Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple”

  • Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs”

We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, unlimited holidays, enhanced parental leave, retirement plans, private healthcare and well-being initiatives.

We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

 

Connecting at Paddle

We’re a ‘digital-first’ company, which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations.

We recognize that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration.

Our Paddle hubs:

  • In Europe: UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub)

  • In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada)

Our hub philosophy creates an engaging experience for all Paddlers, wherever, whenever and however we choose to work.

To support this, we focus hiring within our hubs and will always openly share the available locations for each open position on our job description.

title: Staff Engineer - Telematics
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role
At Samsara, we're looking for a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to help turn growing Telematics products into major businesses. Our new product bets include routing and workforce management for physical operations.
The portfolio has paying customers and early traction. You'll help shape what comes next, working directly with customers to understand their operations, test ideas and build solutions they choose to use. You'll stay close to the work through production, customer adoption and scale.
This is a technical leadership role with substantial hands-on engineering. You'll define important problems and make product and technical decisions alongside Product, Design and Engineering partners. You'll bring the judgement to move forward when requirements are incomplete, and the influence to align other teams around a clear direction.

What you will do

  • Work directly with customers and customer-facing teams to understand unmet needs, test assumptions and identify opportunities worth pursuing. Agree on success measures with Product and Design before investing in a solution.
  • Lead ambiguous initiatives end to end, from discovery and prototypes through production rollout, adoption and iteration. Use customer feedback and product data to decide what to improve, expand or stop.
  • Write and ship code on the critical path. Work across services, APIs and customer-facing experiences as the problem requires, combining technical depth with the ability to learn unfamiliar parts of the product.
  • Set technical direction for your area and align the teams needed to deliver it. Make pragmatic architecture choices that support rapid learning today and reliable growth over time.
  • Own the production quality of what you build. Design for correctness, reliability and performance, plan safe rollouts, and use operational evidence to address the constraints that emerge as usage grows.
  • Increase the effectiveness of the engineers around you through design and code reviews, mentoring senior engineers, and removing recurring obstacles to delivery. Share context and decisions so others can move independently.

About the role:

In this role, you will: 

  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team

What you will bring

  • A track record of shipping customer-facing products and growing them beyond their initial launch. You can explain your contribution to measurable outcomes such as adoption, revenue growth, retention, customer efficiency or cost to serve.
  • Strong product judgement. You have worked directly with customers, clarified poorly defined problems and made decisions using evidence, including changing direction when an initial idea did not work.
  • Deep hands-on software engineering ability, with recent experience designing, implementing and operating production systems. You can move from a prototype to maintainable software and explain the trade-offs along the way.
  • Experience scaling products and the systems behind them. You know how to identify the next constraint, balance speed with reliability, and make technical investments that support customer and business growth.
  • Technical leadership across team boundaries. You have built alignment without formal authority, made other engineers more effective, and communicated difficult choices clearly to technical and business partners.

Experience that could be useful
Experience building B2B software through an early growth stage, or working on routing, workforce management or other software for physical operations. We value evidence of learning a complex customer domain and delivering results; previous industry experience is helpful, rather than essential.


What success looks like
Customers adopt the capabilities you help build and can see the benefit in their day-to-day operations. The products remain dependable as usage grows. Your technical decisions support measurable business progress, and the teams around you can deliver more effectively because of your work.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

 

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job

Design, build, and scale production-grade AI systems that power the next generation of intelligent commerce.

You will work at the intersection of Software Engineering, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to build AI-native products, agentic systems, and platform capabilities used by Mirakl customers and internal teams.

This is a freelance position based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 1 day of remote work per week.

 

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to transform the way our internal teams work, and to have a significant impact on the agentic side of our Saas products.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.


What You'll Do

1. Design & Build AI Systems

  • Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems for both Mirakl internal operations.
  • Develop solutions leveraging: LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Multimodal AI and Evaluation frameworks.
  • Architect complex agentic workflows including tools, memory, retrieval, planning, and guardrails.
  • Rapidly prototype new capabilities and evolve them into scalable, reliable AI production systems.

2. Integrate Across the Stack

  • Connect AI systems to internal platforms, business applications, and data sources across the company.
  • Enable AI agents to interact with systems such as CRM, data platform, Drive, Jira, support tools, and internal knowledge bases.
  • Design robust orchestration layers between models, APIs, tools, retrieval systems, and business workflows.
  • Ensure reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability across the entire AI stack.

3. Iterate for Impact

  • Partner with end users, business teams, Product Managers, and Engineers to identify high-value opportunities for AI.
  • Run pilots and experiments, gather qualitative and quantitative feedback, and measure business impact.
  • Analyze usage patterns, failure modes, costs, latency, and performance metrics.
  • Continuously improve accuracy, reliability, adoption, and user experience through data-driven iteration.

4. Ensure Quality, Security & Reliability

  • Implement evaluation frameworks, guardrails, validation layers, and monitoring systems.
  • Design AI systems that are secure, explainable, and production-ready.
  • Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements.
  • Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices.

5. Drive Adoption & Enablement

  • Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers.
  • Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations.
  • Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company.
  • Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce.

Our stack and tools

  • Languages: Python and SQL

  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models

  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases

  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

What Makes You Successful

  • Strong engineering mindset: able to design reliable and scalable systems
  • Strong AI expertise: able to translate the latest AI capabilities into production products
  • Strong product mindset: able to balance technical excellence with business impact
  • Focus on measurable outcomes, not technical complexity

Success Metrics

  • Product adoption and business impact
  • Performance and reliability of AI systems
  • Quality of AI outputs and evaluation metrics

You'll Love This Job If you have 

  • 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, or related fields
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals
  • Hands-on experience building production AI systems using LLMs, RAG, and AI Agents
  • Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and retrieval systems
  • Experience evaluating AI systems and improving model performance
  • Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments
  • Strong communication skills in English
  • Curiosity, pragmatism, and passion for building AI products

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

Want to join us? Here is our process 

  • A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.
  • An initial 1h30 technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.
  • 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning.
